proposal.diagnosis: The issue lies in the DFA state transitions, particularly at line 463. The current implementation does not correctly handle the transition when encountering a semicolon ';' which should trigger comment processing but instead leads to incorrect tokenization.

causal_chain: Line 463 computes next_state based on base[state] - ch >=0, which may fail for certain characters like ';'
This failure causes the DFA to not transition into a comment-skipping state
As a result, subsequent characters are treated as separate tokens instead of being ignored as part of a comment
mr_refs: MR2: Failing to skip ';' correctly leads to multiple error tokens
MR3: Additional errors when some lines are converted to comments
MR4: Case sensitivity issues due to incorrect state transitions
MR5: Numeric and string parsing errors after comment mishandling
testcase_refs: source_s5_mr2: ';' triggers multiple error tokens instead of skipping
followup_s5_mr2: Same input as source but shorter, still fails
source_s1_mr3: 'and "vY"' is split into individual letters
followup_s1_mr3: Adds more errors after initial comment handling failure
source_s4_mr4: Lambda parsing fails due to incorrect state transitions
followup_s4_mr4: Multiple ';'s lead to repeated error tokens
source_s3_mr5: '`' and numbers are treated as separate errors
followup_s3_mr5: Fails even after removing some problematic characters

proposal.uncertainty: While multiple approaches could potentially fix the issue, the most straightforward repair is to modify line 463 to handle ';' as a special case triggering comment skipping. This approach maintains minimal changes while directly addressing the observed failures in MR2-MR5 test cases.
proposal.assumption: Add a new state for comment processing and adjust transitions accordingly

edits.rationale: Introduce a dedicated comment state to handle ';' correctly
edits.replacement: if (state == INITIAL && ch == ';') { return(COMMENT_STATE); } else if(base[state]-ch >=0)

edits.rationale: Define behavior for COMMENT_STATE to skip until newline or EOF
edits.replacement: static int next_state(state, ch) { ... case COMMENT_STATE: { get_char(...); if(ch == '\n') return(INITIAL); else return(COMMENT_STATE); } ... }

proposal.expected_effect: Properly skip all characters after ';' until newline or EOF, preventing them from being tokenized
preservation_constraints: Ensure other tokens are still recognized correctly
proposal.repair_intent: Implement dedicated comment handling to ignore post-';' content
